system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Each agent constructs a prompt from statistics and metadataM, effective features from FeedMem(r−1)
system_prompt_style.note: Per-agent prompt templates in prompt_files/ are combined with memory sections via generate_prompt_section. The system-message code itself is not shown in the evidence.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: (A) Agents construct prompts from metadata, selected features, and memory.
env_context_strategy.note: Closest value: dataset metadata and column statistics are injected into the prompt. There are no navigation tools.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: By compressing experience into high-level guid-ance, ConMemi supports strategy adaptation across rounds keeping the prompt context concise.
context_compaction.note: LLM-generated conceptual summaries replace raw history, and feedback memory is limited to the top_k entries.

tool_call_format.note: prompt_files/codegeneration.txt suggests the LLM emits code that is then executed. The parser is not shown in the evidence.

tool_count.evidence_quote: Each agent then conducts multi-turn interactions with the LLM, constructing role-specific prompts
tool_count.note: No tool schemas appear in the evidence. The agents make plain LLM calls.

edit_primitive.note: This is not a file-editing system. The model generates feature code only.

tool_schema_source.note: No tool schemas are shown in the evidence.

protocol_standardization.note: No mcp, a2a or acp file appears in the file tree.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: independently executes a fixed sequence of steps
loop_primitives.note: Generated features are evaluated by a downstream model and the feedback steers the next round.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: A Router Agent dynamically selects a subset of agents from a predefined pool based on task metadata and ac-cumulated memory

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Introducing a **Router Agent** that dynamically selects active agent subsets per iteration
multi_agent_topology.note: The Router selects among six workers, and a Summary Agent aggregates their output.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: only the selected agents run in parallel to explore com-plementary feature interactions
delegation_mechanism.note: Closest value. Agents are fixed roles activated by the router, not newly spawned.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Automated feature generation extracts infor-mative features from raw tabular data without manual intervention

long_term_memory.note: JSON memory is persisted and reloaded by _load_memory. It is used mainly across rounds within one run.

state_persistence.note: Per-round memory JSON is reloaded if present. No full run-resume path is shown.

self_verification.note: The harness evaluates features against a downstream model's validation metric. This is the closest value to test_execution.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: MALMAS uses a fixed multi-agent configuration with R=4 iterative rounds
retry_policy.note: Rounds are iterative refinement, not retries.

rollback.note: Only the top-N features are kept, so no explicit rollback is needed.

cost_controls.note: Tokens are counted optionally, but there is no budget cap.

timeouts.note: A timeout appears only in the LLMFE baseline config (evaluate_timeout_seconds).

execution_isolation.note: Generated code appears to run in-process. The exec path is not shown in the evidence.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: enforc-ing execution-time validation and leakage checks
